Portfolio demo — 10 pitchers, 3,578 sampled pitches drawn in 3D (tunneling and 3D-call stats use their full seasons, 25,136 pitches; MLB 2026-03-25 → 2026-10-11). Every pitcher, batter and filter runs live locally via uv run pitch-dataset select-web (/zone3d). Source on GitHub.

3D strike zone

Every pitch as a 3D flight path through the real strike zone — home plate's 17″ pentagon extruded from the knees to the letters — with tunneling at the batter's decision point, back-of-the-zone calls, and batted balls carried out to the field.
